The second loop should now expose a Do-All pattern to DiscoPoP's re-profiling, since each iteration `i` is independent: it only reads `temp[i]` (pre-computed) and writes to `a[i]` and `b[i]` (distinct from all other iterations). The pragma will apply to this loop.
